video.title: Mountain Weather Update 11/7, Meteorologist Chris Tomer

description:
Big storm cycle continues PNW/BC through 11/14 (next storm system hits tonight).  Temps are warm so you'll have to be at mid-mountain or higher for snow accumulation.  
Pattern might not break south until on/after 11/17.  Long, warm wait for the Intermountain West.
